sections.heading: About Our Company
paragraphs: Shri Shyam Astrology Vedic jyotish ke anubhavi acharyon ke saath ghar baithe salah deta hai. Hum kundli, matching, career, prem aur parivar ke vishayon par spasht margdarshan dete hain.
Agar aap kisi bhi desh se sachchi aur result-oriented salah dhoondh rahe hain, to yahan experienced panditon se baat kijiye. Yeh vidya peedhiyon se chali aa rahi hai.

items.question: Jeevansathi kaisa milega? Shaadi ka yog hai?
items.answer: Janmkundli aur grahon ki sthiti se vivah yog samjhai jaati hai.

items.question: Bahut prayas ke baad bhi safalta nahi milti
items.answer: Kundli ki dasha aur yog kabhi-kabhi raste mein rukawat daalte hain.

items.question: Sehat aur parivar mein taalmela kaisa rahega?
items.answer: Grahon, yog aur dasha se sehat ke sanket dekha jaata hai.

items.question: Mere liye best career kaun sa rahega?
items.answer: Kundli ke graha, yog aur dasha dekhkar un kshetron ka sujhav diya jaata hai.

items.question: Sarkari naukri ya private naukri ka yog
items.answer: Lagna, dasha aur grahon se yeh dekha jaata hai ki kaunsi naukri shubh ho sakti hai.

items.question: Kya meri usse shaadi ho payegi?
items.answer: Dono kundliyon ke milan aur vivah yog dekhkar sambandh ki sambhavna batayi jaati hai.

items.question: Dhanwan banne ka sapna kab poora hoga?
items.answer: Dhan se jude grahon aur dasha ka adhyayan karke samay aur upay samjhaye jaate hain.

items.question: Kya kundli mein likha sach hota hai?
items.answer: Kundli janm samay ka aakashi chitra hai. Kai log ise zindagi ke faislon ke liye upyogi maante hain.

sections.heading: How chatting with an astrologer can help you
paragraphs: Jab sawal dimag mein ghumte rehte hain, to jawab ek WhatsApp message door ho sakta hai.
Zindagi ke uchchav-nichav mein Shani ya Rahu dasha jaise samay vishesh savdhani maangte hain.
Sirf samasya-samadhan hi nahi — shaadi ka shubh muhurat, naamkaran, mundan ya rashi ke anuroop ratna ke liye bhi salah milti hai.
